# AI Reg. Index

> A public reference that catalogs AI-governance laws, regulations, executive
> actions, and standards. Every entry links to the government primary source
> and shows the date an editor last verified it. Maintained by SolidCore.ai.
> Text licensed CC BY 4.0.

The register currently tracks 29 instruments across US federal, US state and
local, the European Union, and international standards bodies. Each entry
records: jurisdiction, citation, standing (draft / advisory / enacted / in
force / struck down), effective date, a plain-language summary, the primary
source URL, and cross-framework mappings.

## Core pages

- [The register](https://airegindex.org/): all 29 instruments, grouped by jurisdiction
- [Deadlines](https://airegindex.org/deadlines/): every effective date in the register, in order
- [Comparisons](https://airegindex.org/comparisons/): instruments that cover the same ground, set side by side
- [Method](https://airegindex.org/method/): how entries are written, verified, and kept current
- [Amendments](https://airegindex.org/amendments/): log of instruments that have been amended, superseded, or repealed

## Data

- [register.json](https://airegindex.org/register.json): the whole register as one JSON file, with a schema.org Dataset block
- [Data & fields](https://airegindex.org/data/): field definitions and licensing
- Every register entry page carries per-entry schema.org JSON-LD (Legislation or CreativeWork)

## Notable entries

- [EU AI Act: Article 50](https://airegindex.org/sources/eu-ai-act-article-50-transparency-and-synthetic-media-disclosures/): transparency and synthetic-media disclosure obligations, in force 2 Aug 2026
- [California CPPA ADMT Regulations](https://airegindex.org/sources/california-cppa-automated-decision-making-technology-admt-regulations/): automated decision-making disclosure, in force phased from 1 Jan 2026
- [Texas Responsible AI Governance Act (TRAIGA)](https://airegindex.org/sources/texas-responsible-ai-governance-act-traiga/): in force 1 Jan 2026
- [NIST AI Risk Management Framework](https://airegindex.org/sources/nist-ai-risk-management-framework-ai-rmf-1-0/): the voluntary US baseline many statutes map to
